title: Astragaloside IV ameliorates pressure overload-induced heart failure by enhancing angiogenesis through HSF1/VEGF pathway.
authors: Du, Peizhao; Xu, Linghao; Wang, Yuanqi; Jiao, Tiantian; Cheng, Jing; Zhang, Chunsheng; Tapu, Md Sakibur Rahman; Dai, Jian; Li, Jiming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芪甲苷通过HSF1/VEGF通路改善心衰，仅用分子对接初步涉及蛋白-小分子互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Astragaloside IV(AS-IV), the main active ingredient of Astragalus, has been used as a treatment for heart failure with favorable effects, but its molecular mechanism has not been fully elucidated. Network pharmacological analysis and molecular docking revealed that Heat shock transcription factor 1 (HSF1) is a potential target of AS-IV. We designed cellular and animal experiments to investigate the role and intrinsic molecular mechanisms of AS-IV in ameliorating pressure overload-induced heart failure. In cellular experiments, Myocardial microvascular endothelial cells (MMVECs) were cultured in isolation and stimulated by adding high and low concentrations of AS-IV, and a cell model with down-regulation of HSF1 expression was constructed by using siRNA technology. Changes in the expression of key molecules of HSF1/VEGF signaling pathway and differences in tube-forming ability were detected in different groups of cells using PCR, WB and tube-forming assay. In animal experiments, TAC technology was applied to establish a pressure overload-induced heart failure model in C57 mice, postoperative mice were ingested AS-IV by gavage, and adenoviral transfection technology was applied to construct a mouse model with down-regulation of HSF1 expression.Small animal ultrasound for cardiac function assessment, MASSON staining, CD31 immunohistochemistry, and Western blotting (WB) were performed on the mice. The results showed that AS-IV could promote the expression of key molecules of HSF1/VEGF signaling pathway, enhance the tube-forming ability of MMVECs, increase the density of myocardial capillaries, reduce myocardial fibrosis, and improve the cardiac function of mice with TAC.AS-IV could modulate the HSF1/VEGF signaling pathway to promote the angiogenesis and improve the pressure overload-induced heart failure.
abstract_zh: 黄芪甲苷（Astragaloside IV, AS-IV）是黄芪的主要活性成分，已被用于治疗心力衰竭并具有良好的效果，但其分子机制尚未完全阐明。网络药理学分析和分子对接揭示，热休克转录因子1（Heat shock transcription factor 1, HSF1）是AS-IV的潜在靶点。我们设计了细胞和动物实验，以研究AS-IV在改善压力超负荷诱导的心力衰竭中的作用及其内在分子机制。在细胞实验中，分离培养心肌微血管内皮细胞（Myocardial microvascular endothelial cells, MMVECs），并通过添加高、低浓度的AS-IV进行刺激，同时利用siRNA技术构建HSF1表达下调的细胞模型。通过PCR、WB和管形成实验检测不同组细胞中HSF1/VEGF信号通路关键分子的表达变化及管形成能力的差异。在动物实验中，应用TAC技术建立C57小鼠压力超负荷诱导的心力衰竭模型，术后小鼠通过灌胃摄入AS-IV，并利用腺病毒转染技术构建HSF1表达下调的小鼠模型。对小鼠进行小动物超声心功能评估、MASSON染色、CD31免疫组化及蛋白质印迹（Western blotting, WB）检测。结果表明，AS-IV能促进HSF1/VEGF信号通路关键分子的表达，增强MMVECs的管形成能力，增加心肌毛细血管密度，减少心肌纤维化，并改善TAC小鼠的心功能。AS-IV可通过调节HSF1/VEGF信号通路促进血管生成，从而改善压力超负荷诱导的心力衰竭。
